Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows right lung volume loss with a kinked vessel and the specific absence of the right upper lobe bronchus and vein, which are hallmark features of congenital pulmonary hypoplasia (or agenesis) of the right upper lobe. This distinguishes it from acquired causes like atelectasis or other syndromes like Scimitar or Swyer-James.
